methodologyNotes: Self-serve USD pricing collected from each vendor's official pricing page where accessible on 2026-06-14. Zoom's pricing page (zoom.us/pricing/events) renders JS-only and returned empty content; Zapier's best-webinar-software guide (Dec 2025) was used as primary source for Zoom with corroboration from the GetApp listing. GoTo Webinar's official pricing page (goto.com/webinar/pricing) returned HTTP 403; GetApp and SoftwareAdvice listings were used instead, both confirming the same per-user figures. Livestorm's official page serves EUR pricing; GetApp was used for USD amounts. All non-telephony fields (minutesIncluded, callsIncluded, overagePerMin, overagePerCall) are null on every plan. annualDiscountPct is populated only when both monthly and annual rates appear in the same source. Quote-only/enterprise tiers carry monthlyUsd: null and billingModel: 'custom'.
